set.body:
Bounded first slice: make the competitive objective concrete before implementation.

Deliver a versioned capability/workflow matrix and named evidence protocol in the repository, using pymovements 0.28.0 as the initial candidate pin and rechecking the current release/source identity. Map all five parent targets, the common workflows and eyes4s-specific strengths to public APIs, supported platforms, scientific conventions, fixtures, status and existing/new Mote owners. Explicitly cover reading, QC, blink/I-HMM, dataset access, import/export, standalone plotting, real Studio execution and persistence. Label implementation, tested workflow, empirical qualification and release availability separately.

Correct the narrow factual drift identified in eyes4s.md and detect/README.md. Do not broaden this slice into a documentation overhaul or implement missing methods.

Acceptance: every required capability has evidence or a visible gap; all gaps have a linked, bounded next implementation slice or explicit scope decision. Reuse active owners rather than duplicating them. Freeze rules for comparing methods with differing conventions and for rechecking competitor version drift at final acceptance. A checker rejects missing owners/evidence/status fields and contradictory completion claims. Record source/data/version citations. Initial workstream gates remain open.
set.title: PM1.1 Freeze the pymovements capability matrix and evidence contract
